cases.requirement: Enumerate the complete immutable Git tag registry and reject duplicate or malformed plan authorities.
Treat a completed plan as terminal and never return it as an actionable implicit recovery authority.
Resolve a superseded plan only through its digest-bound successor and select the surviving product train.
Reject a successor edge whose tag, plan document, or canonical plan digest is not an exact identity match.
Reject malformed and type-coercible authority values before plan selection, including non-exact SemVer.
Reject multiple continuity successor claims unless one immutable digest-bound resolution selects exactly one claim.
Reject an explicitly requested terminal plan before it can reach publication or distribution verification.
Re-enumerate lifecycle authority and fail closed when the registry does not converge within the declared attempt bound.
